notes: Full tile, requiresFlatSurface. tree_large: 167 sim tall. Conifer archetype with four curved stems that all start at z=1.5 within r~1.3 of the centre, rise in a smooth U (centreline r = rg + (rb-rg)*sin(pi/2*z/38), reaching r~9 at z38, no lower bulge), then each lean outward on its own curve (power profile with per-stem azimuth drift) to r~12-13 at the crown top. Stem radius 1.0 at the ground, 4.2-4.4 by z9-15, tapering to 0.7 at the tip; a short flared trunk stub (rings z0-14) fills the base. Nothing below z0 (no root stubs or sunken rings). 20 broad pads, all centred at z>=46: one per stem tip plus four per stem on short branches rooted on that stem at z-3, unevenly spaced, tilt up to +/-0.3. Pad layout fitted to the four TCL direction sprites by a local search (position/size/angle/tilt, with occasional stem moves and roots re-hung after each move). The sprite tip is clipped at row 0 of the 128x192 comparison frame. quality.sub=1, tufts=0 to keep exported verts <=2500.
